body.text: Our JEE programme is powered by a top coaching institute in Kota. These are the five parts of it that your child meets every week.

points.text: Faculty from Kota, teaching in Pune.
Study material for the whole syllabus: theory notes, solved examples, chapter-wise problem sets and past IIT JEE papers with solutions.
A test after every chapter, a longer test every fourth week and a full JEE Main mock every month.
One-on-one time with a teacher, in mentoring slots you book.
One evening session, {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, so school comes first.
